summary: Frontend-only FR i18n verification of the iteration-76 cleanup on Storefront > Page tab (live account hostbay@moxx.co). Switched UI language to French via /settings?section=profile, verified the FULL Analytics card, the QR dialog and the Compare storefronts panel, scanned for raw key leaks/console errors, then restored the account language to 'en' (verified with /app/tests/verify_language_en.py -> PASS). ALL 4 requested checks PASSED (100%). Also static-verified the 26 keys exist in all 6 locales (en/pt/fr/es/de/nl) - no missing keys.

issues: Chart X-axis day labels stay English ('Jul 25', 'Aug 4', 'Aug 19') while the whole card is French. formatDayLabel() in AnalyticsWidget.tsx L71-75 calls toLocaleDateString(undefined, ...) so it uses the BROWSER locale, not the app/i18n language. Same for the CustomTooltip date header. Minor, cosmetic, pre-existing - not part of the 26-key scope, but it is the last visible English leftover in this card. Suggested fix: pass i18n.language into toLocaleDateString.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): localize AnalyticsWidget formatDayLabel/CustomTooltip date via i18n.language instead of undefined so chart axis + tooltip dates follow the app language.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsWidget.tsx / HandleQrCode.tsx / StorefrontComparePanel.tsx / Sparkline.tsx all route the new strings through t() with sane English defaultValue fallbacks - no hardcoded strings left in the tested scope.
Sparkline.tsx noDataLabel defaults to 'no data' (English) - acceptable since every call site passes t('storefront.noData'), but a missed future call site would silently render English.
seed_data_creation: None. No data mutated (read-only verification, only the account language toggled FR then restored to EN).
